ayahs.1: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth glorifies Allah. He alone is the Almighty, All-Wise.
ayahs.2: O believers: why do you say what you do not do?
ayahs.3: How despicable in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do!
ayahs.4: Surely Allah loves those who fight in His cause in solid ranks, standing together like a well-built structure.
ayahs.5: Remember when Moses said to his people: 'O my people, why do you hurt me when you know I am Allah's messenger to you?' When they persisted in deviation, Allah caused their hearts to deviate. Allah does not guide a rebellious people.
ayahs.6: Remember when Jesus, son of Mary, said: 'O children of Israel, I am Allah's messenger to you, confirming the Torah before me and giving good news of a messenger after me named Ahmad.' Yet when the Prophet came with clear proofs, they said: 'This is pure magic.'
ayahs.7: Who does greater wrong than one who fabricates lies about Allah when invited to submit to tawhid—the oneness of Allah in worship and reliance? Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
ayahs.8: They wish to extinguish Allah's light with their mouths, but Allah will perfect His light, even to the dismay of those who reject the truth.
ayahs.9: He sent His Messenger with true guidance and the deen—the way of life aligned with divine guidance—of truth, to make it prevail over all other ways, even to the dismay of those who commit shirk.
ayahs.10: O believers: shall I guide you to an exchange that will save you from a painful punishment?
ayahs.11: Have iman in Allah and His Messenger, and strive in Allah's cause with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if only you knew.
ayahs.12: He will forgive your sins and admit you to Gardens under which rivers flow, and house you in splendid homes in the Gardens of Eternity. That is the ultimate triumph.
ayahs.13: He will also give you another favour you long for: help from Allah and an imminent victory. Give good news to the believers.
ayahs.14: O believers: stand up for Allah, as Jesus, son of Mary, asked the disciples: 'Who will stand up with me for Allah?' The disciples replied: 'We will stand up for Allah.' Then a group from the Children of Israel believed while another disbelieved. We supported the believers against their enemies, and they prevailed.
